stories.headline: EU decision to restore Druzhba pipeline draws mixed reactions from Latvian officials
stories.summary: European Commission announced support to restore Russian Druzhba oil pipeline operations. President Rinkēvičs expressed understanding but not approval of decision, viewing it as necessary for Ukraine funding despite concerns about helping Russian infrastructure.

stories.summary: Latvian banking sector profits fell 33.3% to €379.6 million in 2025. Central bank officials discuss inflation risks from Middle East conflict while government considers transferring non-bank lender supervision to Bank of Latvia.
